msgspec.wheel_note: Matching-platform reference wheel only; it is not installed. It ships one native module, msgspec/_core.cpython-311-aarch64-linux-gnu.so, whose .comment section names GCC 14.2.1. PyPI has no py3-none-any wheel for 0.22.0.
msgspec.source_match_note: sdist src/msgspec/_core.c, src/msgspec/atof.h and LICENSE are byte-identical to raw.githubusercontent.com/msgspec/msgspec/0.22.0 (checked 2026-11-17).
msgspec.license_evidence: PyPI License-Expression BSD-3-Clause and sdist LICENSE (Copyright (c) 2021, Jim Crist-Harif)
msgspec.runtime_dependency_note: Requires-Dist lists only the optional toml and yaml extras; neither is installed or used for JSON.
msgspec.documentation_note: msgspec.json.decode(buf, /, *, type='Any', strict=True, dec_hook=None): buf is bytes-like or str; with the default Any type the message is decoded to the default JSON types (observed 2026-11-17).
msgspec.embedded_notice_note: src/msgspec/atof.h carries the Apache-2.0 notice of the Wuffs float-parsing code it is based on; ryu.h (float formatting, Apache-2.0 or Boost-1.0) and itoa.h (integer formatting from yyjson, MIT) carry their upstream notices. The PyPI License-Expression lists only BSD-3-Clause.

build_backend.role: build only (msgspec pyproject requires setuptools>=80 and setuptools-scm>=8); installed with pip --require-hashes from build-requirements.lock
